title: CharacterSet
description: A character set a board can draw. FiestaUI's src/lib/character-sets.ts is the source of truth (validateCharacterSet mirrors this schema and is tested to agree with it); a FiestaBoard output plugin declares one of these in its manifest, optionally partial over `extends`, and FiestaUI materialises it. Merge rule over `extends`: a field given replaces the parent's (arrays and `glyphs` wholesale, never merged), a field left out is inherited, and `version` is never inherited (left out means 1). A plugin bumps `version` whenever its set's content changes; consumers cache by (id, version).

else.description: A set that extends nothing must be complete.

extends.description: A built-in set id or another declared set; fields left out are inherited from it (except `version`).

chars.description: Every printable character the set draws, one code point each; blank is implicit.

glyphs.description: Bitmaps for characters in `chars` the face does not carry: glyphHeight rows of glyphWidth '#'/'.' characters (3×5: 5 rows of 3; 5×7: 7 rows of 5). The exact size is checked against `font` by validateCharacterSet.
